summary: The Decathalon datalist loader is implemented but has not been run, since you asked me not to run tests or repository code. Changes: monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (new; load_decathalon_datalist plus private helper _resolve_path, standard library only); an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py; a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst; and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py (new; class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist with the four specified tests, each cleaning up its temp directory). Line lengths were measured at 120 or under. Extra choices beyond the spec: ValueError if the top-level JSON is not an object or the key's value is not a list; input items are copied rather than mutated; JSON decode errors propagate. Nothing is committed.
